Results.ReviewText: We have had this grill now for about a month. So far so good. I do like the open base design very much. The large wheels are perfect when repositioning the grill. Much better than those tiny casters that never actually roll well. Overall I like the design. It appears to be better designed than our Char Broil (Professional series) that we had before. Although, I seem to have turned out a better steak on the 'ol Charbroil, I think it has to do with my inexperience with this new Weber grill. The grill works fine and I just need more training miles on it. Also, as stated in the manual, "Resist the urge to lift the lid and peek". The first few times I was surprised that the Weber did not burn the meat even though it was on there longer than I felt comfortable. So it just works different than our previous grill. And that is not a bad thing, just a fact. Additionally, I am not used to a temperature gauge that actually works. I look forward to more grilling occasions but so far we really like it. Simple and less parts that can fail. Time will tell and I sure hope that it won't rust as much as the previous grill did, but overall I am happy with the purchase.
Results.Title: New Design

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I have had this grill for about 2 months now, and I am slowly putting it through its paces.  The assembly was pretty easy, instructions are picture oriented instead of word, which can cause confusion, mainly in the placement of the wires/harness.  
   As for the use, best gas grill I have ever owned or used.  I grill a lot for family and friends, and we all agree this has taken the food to the next level.  It fires right up first thing every time, heats up fast, very easy to adjust the temp to the desired range.  Food does not stick terribly, first use there was some as expected.  
    It may look small but it handles large jobs as well was small with ease, the dual side shelves are nice along with the tool holder.  I have zero complaints about this product up to this point.
    Do not let the price tag scare you away.  It is worth every cent, you get what you pay for, especially an outdoor item that sees the weather.  I have learned that the hard way.
Results.Title: Easy Assembly, simple cooking
